title: Turkiye's final draft at UN climate talks doesn't mention fossil fuels
description:
The newest and possibly final agreement to come out of United Nations climate talks doesn't contain the words "fossil fuels", the chief cause of global warming, or specifically call for a move away from climate polluting coal, oil and gas.
The draft from Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum, co-president of the two-week conference in Antalya, Turkey, called COP31, was released in the early hours of Sunday morning.
Kurum gave negotiators only about three hours to make objections or request changes before the draft is presented to what may be the summit's final meeting, where countries will either accept, reject or express their reservations about the agreement.
"We are at a very critical point, and our goal is to reach a conclusion here," Kurum said Sunday, following back-to-back delays to the meeting. "If there is genuine sincerity - if there is a real desire to get something done - I believe it can be achieved in this plenary."
